benchmark: CW10 task order implemented with Meta-World v3 Gymnasium environments
observation_protocol: Use the complete native v3 observation; no truncation to the legacy 12-dimensional layout.
default_reward_mapping: Use each v3 environment's reward_function_version=v1 implementation.
stick_pull_exception: For stick-pull-v3, use the project-local v1_compatible wrapper. It preserves the old v1 reward structure but aligns positions to the v3 observation layout: stick=obs[4:7], handle=obs[11:14], and container=handle+[0.05,0,0]. The installed Meta-World package is not modified.
controller_weight_semantics: Weights are probabilities over selected general-memory semantic segments. They must be positive and sum to 1. Side-channel background and task-specific anchors are configured separately.
